Dappled brown-and-white horse SARAC right, saddle red embroidered rug; small winged fairy Ravijojla hovers uppercenter-left above fire. Smooth small motion, NOT16independent scenes. No motion blur, no image dissolves. Frames1and16 should be adjacent continuous motion, not abrupt cuts.
